# IngestionSource

An ingestion source: one contract with three domain defaults (saas, enterprise, cdc).

## Spec

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spec.domain` | string | No | `saas` | Ingestion domain — the deliberate three-way split of the ingestion contract. One contract, three defaults. | `saas`, `enterprise`, `cdc` |
| `spec.schedule` | string (nullable) | No |  | Optional cron schedule; when unset the source follows its domain default (continuous for cdc, otherwise the connector's own cadence). |  |
| `spec.source` | object (map of string) | No |  | Connector-specific parameters, passed through to the plug verbatim. |  |
| `spec.target` | string | Yes |  | Destination table, e.g. `warehouse.raw.events`. Ingestion lands in Iceberg through the REST catalog — never in a side channel. |  |
